display.purpose: The single Georgia initial in the Larp mark; interface titles remain sans-serif.

headline.purpose: The selected group name in the conversation header.

body.purpose: Default interface copy and supporting text.

confirm.purpose: Valentine Heart action; width varies by dialog context.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Compact button, navigation, and composer-border state changes.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Enabled signed-message send action uses Valentine Heart with Existential Angst text; disabled actions return to neutral.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 31px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--bg); background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font: 750 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: opacity 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { outline: 1px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { color: var(--subtle); background: var(--panel-soft); opacity: 1; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Voice Call Action
components.description: Enabled voice-call join action; disabled styling is neutral until the P2P path is ready.
components.css: .ds-call-action { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--bg); background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 5px; font: 700 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-call-action:hover:not(:disabled) { outline: 1px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-call-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-call-action:disabled { color: var(--subtle); background: var(--panel-soft); border-color: var(--border); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Dialog Confirmation
components.description: Valentine Heart action confirms a dialog task; standard dialogs span the row, while group/media dialogs size to context.
components.css: .ds-dialog-confirm { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; color: var(--bg); background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 720 11px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-confirm:hover:not(:disabled) { outline: 1px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-dialog-confirm:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dialog-confirm:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Control
components.description: Neutral control for device, dialog, and navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--text); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; font: 650 10px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--panel-soft); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Destructive Action
components.description: Valentine Heart treatment for revoking an invitation or leaving/removing a group member.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--bg); background: var(--danger); border: 1px solid var(--danger); border-radius: 6px; font: 650 10px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { outline: 1px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-danger:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Message Composer
components.description: Multiline signed-message entry on a raised surface; focus is carried by the container border.
components.css: .ds-composer { padding: 10px 11px 9px; background: var(--panel-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-composer textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 43px; padding: 0; color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: 0; font: 400 11px/1.55 Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-composer textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Group Row
components.description: The selected real private group is identified by a Dark Charcoal row, Valentine Heart border and consistent chat icon.
components.css: .ds-group-selected { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 6px 9px; color: var(--text); text-align: left; background: var(--panel-soft); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-group-selected:hover { background: var(--panel-soft); } .ds-group-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-group-icon { display: grid; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; color: var(--bg); background: var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-group-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-group-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-group-copy strong { color: var(--text); font: 650 11px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-group-copy small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Privacy Chip
components.description: A compact lock-tag for a real private-group state.
components.html: GRUPO PRIVADO
components.css: .ds-privacy-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 7px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--panel-soft); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; font: 750 8px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-privacy-chip svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Connection Status Card
components.description: A measured connection state with a short primary label and supporting detail.
components.html: Chat P2P preparadoEstado da conexão
components.css: .ds-connection-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--panel-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-connection-card > span:nth-child(2) { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-connection-card strong { color: var(--text); font: 680 11px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-connection-card small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px/1.35 Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-connection-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Local Member Row
components.description: A real local identity is distinct from unverified remote presence; an authorized shared profile may replace the displayed name and avatar.
components.html: PCEste computadorResponsável · neste PC
components.css: .ds-member-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-member-avatar { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; color: var(--bg); background: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; font: 750 8px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-member-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; flex: 1; gap: 3px; } .ds-member-copy strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--text); font: 620 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-member-copy small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 8px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-member-state { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview:
Larp is a compact, invitation-based room for friends who already know whom they want to talk to. The interface favors shared context and clear permissions over discovery: a group is private, voice and screen sharing start only after an explicit action, and message history stays on members' PCs.

The spatial language borrows Discord's scan order—real groups at left, one active conversation in the center, and group members and actions at right—without importing a public-server browser or invented channel hierarchy. The six-color palette uses Dark Charcoal and Eerie Black surfaces, Steam copy, Iron dividers, Valentine Heart accents and Existential Angst as the ground.
keyCharacteristics: Three-pane Windows desktop workspace: groups, conversation, group details and members.
Invitation-based privacy and real membership/connection states.
An optional shared profile adds a display name and WebP avatar only to authorized member and message views.
Layered near-black surfaces, thin separators, restrained semantic accents.
Visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Valentine Heart identifies actions, focus, borders and non-text status indicators; Steam copy stays on dark surfaces. Text on Valentine Heart uses Existential Angst. Disabled actions return to neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Group Name Leads Rule
rules.body: The selected group title is the single headline; membership and connection details remain secondary.

rules.name: The Shared Profile Privacy Rule
rules.body: Display names and cropped WebP avatars are optional and visible only to the owner and members of common private groups. Clearing fields restores the PC pseudonym; signed envelopes remain unchanged.

dos: Do preserve the exact frontmatter palette roles when adding controls or states.
Do reserve Valentine Heart for actions and non-text accents while preserving readable Steam text on dark surfaces.
Do use Existential Angst text on Valentine Heart buttons.
Do distinguish authorized membership from measured reachability; keep focus visible and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't use Steam text on Valentine Heart or Valentine Heart as normal text on Dark Charcoal.
Don't color a disabled action as if it were ready.
Don't add public-server discovery, channels, invented members, presence, or messages to Larp.
Don't use shadows to separate panels; use the existing tonal layers and 1px borders.
